whatsapp.content: leo, the contract with psg is almost done. need your signature on the final pages
ok. send it over. ill sign today
also the apartment in paris is ready. antonela can move in anytime
good. thanks for handling everything. i know it was crazy
thats my job son. just focus on football. leave the rest to me
sponsors are asking for more appearances. can you do the press conference next week?
yeah. schedule it. i have training but can do after
also the copa america celebrations - need to coordinate with the fa
ok. just tell me when and where
psg wants to extend your contract. offering another year
tell them ill think about it. focusing on the world cup right now
i understand. but just keep it in mind. good money on the table
yeah i know. we'll talk after the world cup
congratulations son. from the bottom of my heart. you did it
thank you papa. couldnt have done it without your support all these years
im so proud of you. more than youll ever know. im just so emotional right now
leo... the miami offer is serious. i spoke to them. they really want you
i know. i want to go. the money isnt everything. i want to enjoy football again
i understand. its your decision. just make sure its the right one
its the right one. i feel it in my gut. let them know im coming
miami wants to do a new jersey launch. they want you to be there
ok. set it up. the fans have been amazing here. i want to do it for them
will do. hows the family settling in? are the boys enjoying miami?
they love it. its good for them. for all of us. thanks for looking out for me papa
always son. always. proud of you
